newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER - AJAX SIGN GEORGIAN STRIKER ARVELADZE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER - AJAX SIGN GEORGIAN STRIKER ARVELADZE.

text.p: Ajax Amsterdam will on Thursday sign Georgian international striker Shota Arveladze on a five-year contract from Turkish first division side Trabzonspor, the Dutch club said.

Arveladze, 24, was the top scorer in the Turkish first division in the 1995-96 season, scoring 25 goals -- none of them penalties -- in 34 matches. He has scored nine goals in 34 appearances so far this season.
The striker has also scored four goals for Georgia during their current World Cup 1998 qualifying campaign. Before moving to Trabzonspor, he played for Dinamo Tblisi.
